note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, as carried by the competition kit). trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & cleanup) and it pops last.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies, in any order.
The platinum pops automatically when the last one lands.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The biggest grind in the set: reach 100% completion (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which appears after the story). Only selected portions are required — the roadmap table above lists them. The slow parts are the 42 Shooting Range gold medals, the 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 stunts and 70 of the 80 Challenges. Everything you did before the ending already counts toward it.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the robberies first: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Earn all 42 Shooting Range gold medals and finish all 42 Drone Time Trials.
Complete 70 of the 80 Challenges — leave the ten hardest for last.

trophies.missable_note: One morning after the early Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia brings up meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks out to the balcony. The other 17 spots remain open in free roam.

steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate when prompted.
Learn the technique, then meditate at the other 17 marked spots across Leonida.
Check the Meditation count in Progress > Stats (15 of 18 is enough for 100%; all 18 for this trophy).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then escape the heat. The easy route: rob a bank vault, which instantly puts you at four stars, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone on the map. One reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It often pops by itself during the vault robberies.
steps: With your partner, reach a four-star wanted level (a bank vault robbery does it instantly).
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.

trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the level must stay up through all three. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well: rob one, move straight to the next, and keep the police chasing but not catching you. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not panic if nothing happens at once.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop and keep your wanted level.

Leave the third store and wait about 30 seconds for the pop.

trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Keep both of them training until both bars are full.
steps: Take Jason and Lucia to the gym together.
Work out until both characters' Strength is maxed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. This is a passive counter: every choice that moves your profile — robberies, kills, escapes, jobs done one way or the other — adds up. Play the game the way the roadmap asks and the counter climbs on its own; check it in Progress > Stats if you want to see how far along you are.
steps: Play through the story and side content.
Keep doing actions that affect your Criminal Profile until the count reaches 500.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed, but the shape of it is clear from the description: drive past on a vehicle and land a melee hit that bowls the target over. Try it from a slow-moving car or bike with a melee weapon, and watch the guide sites for a confirmed method.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit that knocks them down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults and gang operations pay in them — and fences turn them into clean cash. The counter is cumulative, so every fence trip adds up; the 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and that checklist line finish together.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Fence them through your contacts until $250,000 is laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across any shops. It adds up fast once the robbery money starts flowing: clothes, weapons, car mods and food all count. If you are short near the end, buy the most expensive things you still want — there is no penalty for spending.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties — $160,000 in total. Garages are also where the cars you collect live, so buy them as you find vehicles worth keeping (see On the Spot). Save the money for them during the story and buy the last ones during cleanup.
steps: Buy all eight garage properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you own will do — register the ones you already drive, and use your garages (see Little Boxes) to keep the good ones. The app is the in-game way to call your cars to you, so registering is worth doing even without the trophy.
steps: Own ten vehicles.
Register all ten in the Scooter Bros app.
